$comment: The declarative task vocabulary (ADR-0005 F5): every action and task-event category an experiment file can name, phase 2 included. ADR-0002 keeps the format within 12 actions and 6 event categories, and phase 2 extends the same format, so its names count too; test/frontend/vocabulary.test.ts fails CI over budget or when a generated file is stale. After an edit, run `npm run vocabulary`, which writes schema/generated/vocabulary.schema.json, src/task/vocabulary.generated.ts and threemaze/core/vocabulary.py. phase 1: accepted by format 1.0; phase 2: name reserved, rejected until a later minor version (ADR-0005 F6, F10). formerNames: names from v0.3, the designs and the prototypes, kept for did-you-mean diagnostics; never reuse one.

actions.name: reward
actions.summary: Ask the rig runtime for one reward on the rig's reward role, as a pulse width (durationMs) or, on a rig whose file holds a valve calibration, a volume (volumeUl); the runtime applies the rig file's safety envelope (ADR-0002).

actions.name: teleport
actions.summary: Move the agent to a spawn of the current world between two samples: feet snapped to the floor, epoch + 1, zone exits with cause "teleport" (ADR-0001 R4; ADR-0002, Stamps).

actions.name: freeze
actions.summary: Discard locomotion input (true) or apply it again (false); discarded samples are still logged.

actions.name: display
actions.summary: Show black instead of the world (blank; the blanking colour of D14 a) or the world again (on); frames are rendered and logged either way. A blank inter-trial interval is display blank plus a timer.

actions.name: timer
actions.summary: Start a named timer for a duration in seconds, or cancel it; a started timer fires timer:<id> on the first device sample with t_dev >= its due time (ADR-0002, Clock and order).

actions.name: trial
actions.summary: Start the next planned trial, or end the open one with an outcome that goes to the trials table.

actions.name: endSession
actions.summary: End the session after the current sample.

actions.name: setGain
actions.summary: Scale forward, lateral and yaw motion by per-axis factors from the next sample; gain 1 stays exact.
actions.pending: Joins format 1.0 if experiment B2 runs on v1.0-rc (owner decision D13, open).

actions.name: setCue
actions.summary: Switch a cue object to one of its declared states.

actions.name: emit
actions.summary: Send a message with data to a plugin or an external controller.

actions.name: switchWorld
actions.summary: Switch to another world of the experiment, with a transition (multi-world experiments).

eventCategories.name: enter
eventCategories.summary: The agent's axis point at feet + 1.15 entered the zone in this sample (ADR-0001 R1).

eventCategories.name: exit
eventCategories.summary: The agent's axis point left the zone in this sample; the exits a teleport causes carry cause "teleport".

eventCategories.name: timer
eventCategories.summary: The timer started with that id is due: the first device sample with t_dev >= its due time.

eventCategories.name: input
eventCategories.summary: A non-motion input such as a lick, dispatched in arrival order before zone events (ADR-0002, Clock and order).
eventCategories.pending: input:lick joins format 1.0 only if lick-contingent reward is needed (owner decision D29, open).

eventCategories.name: message
eventCategories.summary: A message from a plugin or an external controller.

eventCategories.name: world
eventCategories.summary: The switch to another world has completed (multi-world experiments).
